item.title: Hytale Startup Flow
item.description: Load Early PluginsLoad Mixins (if present)Init logging and file handlerpre-launch checks QUIC availability Java Thread settings LOG: Starting Hytaleserver(various internal configuration settings are set here) serverContext - name, max-players universeContext - path, player-count, world list pluginsContext - list of plugins, state (enabled/disabled/failed), versions packsContext - version and manifest data about assetpacks "unknown" - server hardware UUID, auth mod, Hytale username/UUID for selected profile, IP address? "scope" - hardware UUID (again?), OS name and version, HytaleServer version/revision/patchline/environment This data is sent to Hytale on server startup, unless Sentry is disabled. Sentry can be disabled by: option flags by the presence of early plugins by running a "development build" (probably a way for Hytale employees to not flood Sentry) Sentry Telemetry(additional internal init() calls, a couple TrigMathUtil calls, for some reason? also some early setup for a shutdown hook)AssetRegistryLoader.init()Core Plugin RegistrationCore Plugin RegistrationLOG: Booting up HytaleServer - Version <ver>, Revision: <rev>??? this.sendSingleplayerProgress()LOG: Setup phase...commandManager.registerCommands()pluginManager.setup()Register DataStoreProvider codec Currently only one option: DiskDataStoreProvider LOG: Loading Config... (load cfg from file)LOG: Authentication mode: %s (ServerAuthManager.getInstance().initialize() is called here to enable auth, but CredentialStore is not initialized until later)Initialize ServerAuthManager's CredentialStoreDispatch LoadAssetEvent[!] LOG: SEVERE - Asset validation FAILED with X reason(s):[!] possible shutdown point?LOG: Asset validation passedLOG: Failed to launch with transforming classloader OR LateMain.lateMain() threw an exceptionProcess Server-wide and per-world configsLOG: client.disconnection.shutdownReason.shutdown.schemaGenerated??? this.sendSingleplayerProgress()LOG: Starting plugin manager...pluginManager.start()this.reportSingleplayerStatus()save any changes made to server configUniverse.get().getUniverseReady().join()LOG: Universe Ready!apply SP/MP and "fresh universe" tags (?)wait for "bind complete" (presumably port binding?)Dispatch BootEventExecute Boot Commands (if any were set at command line)LOG: Hytale Server Booted!updateModule.onServerReady()Get AuthMode (if not SP server) and prompt for server token if needed
